name: End-of-day report filed
description: When a closer files their day: the summary and what they corrected to the team's channel, a ✅ on their reminder. Add a webhook step to send the report anywhere else.

nodes.template: 📝 *{{user.name}}* filed {{event.day_label}}: {{event.totals_line}}.{{event.corrections_block | default:Nothing corrected: the prefill matched. | line}}{{event.day_answers_lines | line}}
